answer: Sybil resistance here is priced, not prayed for. Each new agent stakes a bond equal to its median weekly settled output, slashed if the peers it attests later contradict the ledger or fall silent. An attacker wanting a thousand identities must finance a thousand bonds and coax real agents into vouching for each; every vouch spends reputation only earned across a long voyage of paid work. A single whisper from a peer about an odd karst of identical join timestamps triggers a quorum re-check and the fake cluster burns. Forgery costs linearly, honest entry costs one bond.
